set.layering_notes: This is the main county gap source for the whole San Diego region, including the City of San Diego for IHTF money (HOME, HOME-ARP, CDBG and PLHA are limited to the Urban County and HOME Consortium cities listed in the NOFA). Loan terms: 3% simple interest, 55-year term, 50% residual receipts shared proportionally with other public lenders, GP loans may not be repaid ahead of the County, TCAC developer fee limits, replacement reserves $375 per unit (new construction), $500 per PSH unit, $720 per unit (rehab), $4,000 initial compliance monitoring fee. All other local funds must be committed before applying and senior lenders must subordinate to the regulatory agreement. Funds are reserved for 24 months and the County will not split or combine awards if a deal converts between 9% and 4%. Scoring (165 points) weights geographic location 30, financing gap 20, experience 20, target population 15, services 15, overall 15. Federal sources carry Davis-Bacon, NEPA, Section 3, BABA (HOME) and relocation rules; state prevailing wage on County loans turns on the Labor Code 1720(c) exemptions.
